rendered.name: Wann kann ich im Hotel Berlin, Berlin einchecken?
rendered.text: Check-in im Hotel Berlin, Berlin ist ab 15:00. Früher Check-in ab 06:00 gibt es für 30 €, wenn ein Zimmer bereit ist — oder die Nacht davor buchen für garantierten frühen Zugang. Wenn du früher ankommst, bewahrt das Guest Care Center dein Gepäck auf, bis das Zimmer bereit ist.

rendered.name: Gibt es Parkplätze im Hotel Berlin, Berlin?
rendered.text: Ja. Das Hotel Berlin, Berlin hat eine Tiefgarage mit 208 Plätzen: 4 € pro Stunde, maximal 25 € pro Tag. Einfahrtshöhe 1,80 m. Zufahrt über die Karl-Heinrich-Ulrichs-Straße.

rendered.name: Sind Haustiere im Hotel Berlin, Berlin erlaubt?
rendered.text: Ja, Haustiere sind im Hotel Berlin, Berlin willkommen. 30 € pro Nacht. Haustiere sind auch beim Frühstück willkommen.

rendered.name: Wie komme ich vom BER-Flughafen zum Hotel Berlin, Berlin?
rendered.text: Mit RE7 oder RB14 zum Zoologischen Garten, dann Bus 100 bis Lützowplatz — direkt vor dem Hotel. Rund 45–55 Minuten.

rendered.name: Wo kann ich mein Gepäck vor dem Check-in oder nach dem Check-out lassen?
rendered.text: Gepäckaufbewahrung gibt es vor dem Check-in und nach dem Check-out. Frag im Guest Care Center neben der Lobby.

rendered.name: Wann ist der Check-out?
rendered.text: Check-out ist bis 12:00. Späterer Check-out läuft über die Lobby Hosts — am Abreisetag in der Lobby fragen.

rendered.name: Wann gibt es im Hotel Berlin, Berlin Frühstück, und was kostet es?
rendered.text: Frühstück gibt es Mo–Fr 06:30–10:00, Sa/So bis 11:00. Volles Buffet mit veganen Optionen. 23 € Erwachsene, 12 € ab 6 Jahren.

rendered.name: Wann hat Lütze auf?
rendered.text: Lütze hat von 10:00–01:00 auf.

rendered.name: Wann hat der Wundermart auf?
rendered.text: Wundermart ist 24/7 in der Lobby. Zahlung nur mit Karte.

rendered.name: Darf ich im Hotel rauchen?
rendered.text: Nein. Das Haus ist ein Nichtraucherhotel. Rauchen im Zimmer kostet 250 € Reinigungsgebühr.

rendered.name: Wann hat das Gym auf?
rendered.text: Das Gym ist 24/7 für Hotelgäste offen.

rendered.name: Wie nutze ich die Sauna?
rendered.text: Die Sauna ist auf Anfrage, 45 Minuten Vorlauf. Ein Slot läuft über das Guest Care Center.

rendered.name: Gibt es Zimmerservice?
rendered.text: Kein Zimmerservice — Abholung an der Bar.

rendered.name: Kann ich bar zahlen?
rendered.text: Nein. Zahlung nur mit Karte und kontaktlos — kein Bargeld. Das gilt auch für Essen und Trinken im Haus.

rendered.name: Wie lautet die Stornierungsbedingung beim flexiblen Tarif?
rendered.text: Flexible Buchungen im Hotel Berlin, Berlin können bis 18:00 am Anreisetag kostenfrei storniert werden. Bei später Stornierung oder No-Show werden 90 % der ersten Nacht berechnet.

rendered.name: Gibt es E-Laden?
rendered.text: Ja. 8 AC-Punkte, bis 22 kW, Typ 2.

rendered.name: Kann ich ein Fahrrad unterstellen?
rendered.text: Ja. Es gibt eine Fahrradgarage mit E-Bike-Ladung.

rendered.name: Gibt es eine Minibar?
rendered.text: Die Minibar ist leer und als eigener Kühlschrank gedacht. Snacks und Getränke gibt es 24/7 im Wundermart in der Lobby.

rendered.name: Wie oft kommt Housekeeping?
rendered.text: Housekeeping kommt täglich. Bettwäsche wird alle drei Tage gewechselt.

rendered.name: Kann ich die Klimaanlage einstellen?
rendered.text: Ja. Die Zimmertemperatur lässt sich um etwa ±3 °C regeln.

rendered.name: Ist das Leitungswasser trinkbar?
rendered.text: Ja. Berliner Leitungswasser ist Trinkwasser.

rendered.name: Kann das Hotel Babysitting organisieren?
rendered.text: Ja. Das Guest Care Center vermittelt eine Babysitting-Agentur.

rendered.name: What time can I check in at Hotel Berlin, Berlin?
rendered.text: Check-in at Hotel Berlin, Berlin is from 15:00. Early check-in from 06:00 is available for €30 if a room is ready — or book the night before for guaranteed early access. If you arrive before your room is ready, the Guest Care Center can store your luggage until it is.

rendered.name: Is there parking at Hotel Berlin, Berlin?
rendered.text: Yes. Hotel Berlin, Berlin has an underground garage with 208 spaces: €4 per hour, maximum €25 per day. Entry height is 1.80 m. Access is from Karl-Heinrich-Ulrichs-Straße.

rendered.name: Are pets allowed at Hotel Berlin, Berlin?
rendered.text: Yes, pets are welcome at Hotel Berlin, Berlin. There is a charge of €30 per night. Pets are also welcome at breakfast.

rendered.name: How do I get to Hotel Berlin, Berlin from BER airport?
rendered.text: Take the RE7 or RB14 to Zoologischer Garten, then Bus 100 to Lützowplatz — right outside the hotel. Around 45–55 minutes total.

rendered.name: Where can I store luggage before check-in or after check-out?
rendered.text: Luggage storage is available before check-in and after check-out. Ask at the Guest Care Center beside the lobby.

rendered.name: What time is check-out?
rendered.text: Check-out is by 12:00. Later check-out is arranged with the lobby hosts — ask on the morning you leave.

rendered.name: When is breakfast at Hotel Berlin, Berlin, and what does it cost?
rendered.text: Breakfast is served Monday to Friday 06:30–10:00, and Saturday and Sunday until 11:00. It is a full buffet with vegan options. €23 for adults, €12 from age 6.

rendered.name: When is Lütze open?
rendered.text: Lütze is open 10:00–01:00.

rendered.name: When is Wundermart open?
rendered.text: Wundermart is 24/7 in the lobby. Card payment only.

rendered.name: Can I smoke in the hotel?
rendered.text: No. This is a non-smoking hotel. Smoking in the room incurs a €250 cleaning fee.

rendered.name: When is the gym open?
rendered.text: The gym is open 24/7 for hotel guests.

rendered.name: How do I use the sauna?
rendered.text: The sauna is on request, with 45 minutes’ notice. Ask Guest Care to book a slot.

rendered.name: Is there room service?
rendered.text: No room service — collect food and drinks at the bar.

rendered.name: Can I pay with cash?
rendered.text: No. The hotel is card and contactless only — no cash. This applies to food and drink in the hotel too.

rendered.name: What is the cancellation policy for a flexible rate?
rendered.text: Flexible rate bookings at Hotel Berlin, Berlin can be cancelled free of charge until 18:00 on the day of arrival. A late cancellation or no-show is charged at 90% of the first night.

rendered.name: Is there EV charging?
rendered.text: Yes. 8 AC points, up to 22 kW, Type 2.

rendered.name: Can I store a bike?
rendered.text: Yes. There is a bike garage with e-bike charging.

rendered.name: Is there a minibar?
rendered.text: The minibar is empty on purpose — use it as your own fridge. Snacks and drinks are at Wundermart in the lobby, 24/7.

rendered.name: How often is housekeeping?
rendered.text: Housekeeping is daily. Bed linen is changed every three days.

rendered.name: Can I adjust the air conditioning?
rendered.text: Yes. The room climate can be adjusted by about ±3 °C.

rendered.name: Is the tap water drinkable?
rendered.text: Yes. Berlin tap water is drinking water.

rendered.name: Can the hotel arrange babysitting?
rendered.text: Yes. Guest Care can book a babysitting agency for you.

jsonld.text: Ja — über die 9 vom Zimmertelefon, dann bringt Guest Care ein Bügeleisen.

jsonld.name: Wo bekomme ich einen Adapter?
jsonld.text: Adapter liegen im Wundermart in der Lobby, 24/7, Zahlung per Karte.

jsonld.name: Kann das Hotel Babysitting organisieren?
jsonld.text: Ja. Das Guest Care Center vermittelt eine Babysitting-Agentur.

jsonld.name: Wo ist das Business Center?
jsonld.text: Das Business Center ist in der Lobby.

jsonld.name: Wo ist der nächste Geldautomat?
jsonld.text: Commerzbank hat einen Geldautomaten gegenüber dem Hotel.

jsonld.name: Kann ich im Hotel Geld wechseln?
jsonld.text: Im Haus gibt es keine Wechselstube. Die nächste ist im Bahnhof Zoologischer Garten.

jsonld.name: Gibt es einen Hausarzt in der Nähe?
jsonld.text: Hausarzt am Nollendorfplatz, etwa 10 Minuten zu Fuß.

jsonld.name: Wo ist die nächste Apotheke?
jsonld.text: Quartier Apotheke Nolleturm, Nollendorfplatz 3–4. Außerdem Apotheke am Wittenbergplatz, Bayreuther Straße 44.

jsonld.name: Wo kann ich ein Auto mieten?
jsonld.text: StarCar, Schillstraße 9, 1 Minute. Avis, Hertz und Europcar, Tauentzienstraße 9–11, 10 Minuten.

jsonld.name: Wie bekomme ich ein Taxi?
jsonld.text: Das Guest Care Center neben der Lobby ruft eins. Halteplatz am Lützowplatz.

jsonld.name: Wo kann ich joggen?
jsonld.text: Am nächsten ist der Tiergarten. Guest Care zeigt dir auch die Kanalrunden.

rendered.name: What time can I check in at Hotel Berlin, Berlin?
rendered.text: Check-in at Hotel Berlin, Berlin is from 15:00. Early check-in from 06:00 is available for €30 if a room is ready — or book the night before for guaranteed early access. If you arrive before your room is ready, the Guest Care Center can store your luggage until it is.

rendered.name: Is there parking at Hotel Berlin, Berlin?
rendered.text: Yes. Hotel Berlin, Berlin has an underground garage with 208 spaces: €4 per hour, maximum €25 per day. Entry height is 1.80 m. Access is from Karl-Heinrich-Ulrichs-Straße.

rendered.name: Are pets allowed at Hotel Berlin, Berlin?
rendered.text: Yes, pets are welcome at Hotel Berlin, Berlin. There is a charge of €30 per night. Pets are also welcome at breakfast.

rendered.name: How do I get to Hotel Berlin, Berlin from BER airport?
rendered.text: Take the RE7 or RB14 to Zoologischer Garten, then Bus 100 to Lützowplatz — right outside the hotel. Around 45–55 minutes total.

rendered.name: Where can I store luggage before check-in or after check-out?
rendered.text: Luggage storage is available before check-in and after check-out. Ask at the Guest Care Center beside the lobby.

rendered.name: What time is check-out?
rendered.text: Check-out is by 12:00. Later check-out is arranged with the lobby hosts — ask on the morning you leave.

rendered.name: Where is lost property?
rendered.text: Lost property is handled by the Guest Care Center beside the lobby, 24/7.

rendered.name: How does the do-not-disturb sign work?
rendered.text: Use the do-not-disturb sign on your door. Housekeeping will skip the room until you take it down.

rendered.name: When is breakfast at Hotel Berlin, Berlin, and what does it cost?
rendered.text: Breakfast is served Monday to Friday 06:30–10:00, and Saturday and Sunday until 11:00. It is a full buffet with vegan options. €23 for adults, €12 from age 6.

rendered.name: When is Lütze open?
rendered.text: Lütze is open 10:00–01:00.

rendered.name: When is Wundermart open?
rendered.text: Wundermart is 24/7 in the lobby. Card payment only.

rendered.name: How do I connect to the hotel WiFi?
rendered.text: Ask at the Guest Care Center beside the lobby for the current network details. They will get you online.

rendered.name: Is there a minibar?
rendered.text: The minibar is empty on purpose — use it as your own fridge. Snacks and drinks are at Wundermart in the lobby, 24/7.

rendered.name: How do I use the room safe?
rendered.text: Room safes are set up through the Guest Care Center beside the lobby.

rendered.name: How often is housekeeping?
rendered.text: Housekeeping is daily. Bed linen is changed every three days.

rendered.name: Can I get an iron?
rendered.text: Yes — dial 9 from the room phone and Guest Care will bring an iron.

rendered.name: Where can I get a plug adapter?
rendered.text: Adapters are in Wundermart in the lobby, 24/7, card payment.

rendered.name: Can I adjust the air conditioning?
rendered.text: Yes. The room climate can be adjusted by about ±3 °C.

rendered.name: Is the tap water drinkable?
rendered.text: Yes. Berlin tap water is drinking water.

rendered.name: What does the room phone cost?
rendered.text: Calls in Germany are €0.40 per minute. International calls are €0.80–€3.20 per minute.

rendered.name: Can I smoke in the hotel?
rendered.text: No. This is a non-smoking hotel. Smoking in the room incurs a €250 cleaning fee.

rendered.name: When is the gym open?
rendered.text: The gym is open 24/7 for hotel guests.

rendered.name: How do I use the sauna?
rendered.text: The sauna is on request, with 45 minutes’ notice. Ask Guest Care to book a slot.

rendered.name: Where is the business center?
rendered.text: The business center is in the lobby.

rendered.name: Where is Guest Care?
rendered.text: The Guest Care Center is beside the lobby and open 24/7.

rendered.name: Is there room service?
rendered.text: No room service — collect food and drinks at the bar.

rendered.name: Can I pay with cash?
rendered.text: No. The hotel is card and contactless only — no cash. This applies to food and drink in the hotel too.

rendered.name: Where is the nearest ATM?
rendered.text: Commerzbank has an ATM across the street from the hotel.

rendered.name: Can I change money at the hotel?
rendered.text: There is no bureau de change in the hotel. The nearest is at Bahnhof Zoologischer Garten.

rendered.name: Is there EV charging?
rendered.text: Yes. 8 AC points, up to 22 kW, Type 2.

rendered.name: Can I store a bike?
rendered.text: Yes. There is a bike garage with e-bike charging.

rendered.name: Where can I rent a car?
rendered.text: StarCar is at Schillstraße 9, about a minute away. Avis, Hertz and Europcar are at Tauentzienstraße 9–11, about 10 minutes.

rendered.name: How do I get a taxi?
rendered.text: Ask the Guest Care Center beside the lobby to call one. There is a rank at Lützowplatz.

rendered.name: Where can I go for a run?
rendered.text: Tiergarten is the closest loop. Guest Care can point you to the canal paths as well.

rendered.name: Who do I call for a doctor out of hours?
rendered.text: The on-call medical service is 116 117. For emergencies call 112.

rendered.name: What is the emergency number?
rendered.text: Call 112 for fire, ambulance, or police emergency. Trained staff are in the building around the clock.

rendered.name: Is there a GP nearby?
rendered.text: There is a GP at Nollendorfplatz, about a 10-minute walk.

rendered.name: Where is the nearest pharmacy?
rendered.text: Quartier Apotheke Nolleturm, Nollendorfplatz 3–4. There is also a pharmacy at Wittenbergplatz, Bayreuther Straße 44.

rendered.name: Can the hotel arrange babysitting?
rendered.text: Yes. Guest Care can book a babysitting agency for you.
